3rd - Volume 3/26/2026 1:51 PM
It’s both, the total of your masks is the maximum points you can score across the whole tournament. So in a given match, you are trying to win 5 rounds. You need a higher score than your opponent to win the round. However any points you score are calculated from the number your masks roll + potential halving and that rolled number then takes away from the points your mask can score
1:55 PM
Let’s say Venus plays Brett’s mask and you play Mikey’s. These were both played so they have a half penalty, and in theory they are halved again because you both know who owned them. Brett’s mask rolls 1-12 and Mikey’s mask rolls 1-11. Let’s say Bretts rolls a 9 and Mikey’s rolls a 4. The actual score Venus would get is 9/4, rounded down. So that’s 2.25. Becoming 2. Your score would be 4/4. Becoming 1. Therefore Venus wins the round. However now Brett’s mask can only roll 1-3 cause she rolled a 9. Mikey’s mask can now only roll 1-7, cause you rolled a 4. Keep in mind the roll is hidden, but the score is public so you don’t know rounding effects. And if your rolls divided by 4 or by 2 depending on mask, is less than 1, you score 0 points for that round
